<style id="lq773-css">
/* V77.3 — Ember & Ink: dialogue, character expressions, factual context */
#chat{--lq-mood:#9aaab6;--lq-accent:#e8c98d;width:min(1120px,calc(100vw - 32px))!important;max-height:min(760px,calc(100dvh - 24px))!important;border-radius:18px!important;background:linear-gradient(130deg,#233139,#10191f 48%,#19242b)!important;box-shadow:0 24px 90px #000d,0 0 0 3px #111a20,0 0 0 4px #a78c594a!important;}
#chat[style*="display: block"],#chat[style*="display:block"]{grid-template-columns:minmax(270px,34%) minmax(0,1fr)}
#chat .lq772-sidebar{padding:16px;gap:11px;background:radial-gradient(ellipse at top,#34474a,#151f26 60%);border-right:1px solid #bfa77940}
#chat .lq772-main{padding:18px 22px 14px}
#chat .lq772-stage{height:clamp(180px,34vh,280px);border-radius:10px;background:#233841;border:1px solid #c7ac7a88;box-shadow:0 8px 24px #0007,inset 0 0 0 3px #151d26}
#chat .lq772-stage:before{inset:5px;border:1px solid #e8c98d60;mask-image:none;border-radius:6px;z-index:6}
#chat .lq772-stage:after{background:linear-gradient(0deg,#0b121a 0%,#0b121a12 32%,transparent 70%,#0b121a88),radial-gradient(ellipse at 50% 40%,#ffffff08,transparent 45%,#070f1977 99%)}
#chat .lq772-landscape{opacity:.68;}
#chat .lq771-portrait{background:radial-gradient(ellipse at 50% 36%,color-mix(in srgb,var(--lq-mood) 23%,transparent),transparent 62%)!important;overflow:hidden;}
#chat .lq771-portrait canvas{width:min(92%,245px)!important;max-height:88%;filter:drop-shadow(0 6px 0 #070e1740) drop-shadow(0 8px 15px #0009);transform-origin:50% 85%;}
#chat .lq771-portrait[data-mood="disagreeing"] canvas{animation:lq773-firm 3s ease-in-out infinite}#chat .lq771-portrait[data-mood="worried"] canvas{animation:lq773-worry 3.2s ease-in-out infinite}#chat .lq771-portrait[data-mood="formal"] canvas{animation:none}@keyframes lq773-firm{50%{translate:0 2px}}@keyframes lq773-worry{40%,60%{rotate:1deg;translate:0 1px}}
#chat .lq773-emblem{position:absolute;top:35px;right:13px;z-index:5;width:38px;height:38px;display:grid;place-items:center;font:700 23px Georgia,serif;color:var(--lq-mood);background:#0c1828da;border:1px solid var(--lq-mood);border-radius:50%;box-shadow:0 0 16px color-mix(in srgb,var(--lq-mood) 26%,transparent);}
#chat .lq772-scene-tag{color:#fff0ce;max-width:calc(100% - 28px);font-size:10px;letter-spacing:.7px}#chat .lq772-day{font-size:10px}#chat .lq772-status{border-radius:3px;font-size:9px;color:#e8d5a9}
#chat .lq771-identity{padding:1px 3px}#chat .name{font-size:24px!important;color:#f7dfae!important}#chat .lq772-activity{font-size:12px;color:#c4d0d4}
#chat .lq773-emotion{padding:9px 11px;margin-top:9px;border:1px solid color-mix(in srgb,var(--lq-mood) 40%,transparent);background:linear-gradient(120deg,color-mix(in srgb,var(--lq-mood) 12%,#18242c),#142028);border-radius:8px;display:grid;gap:3px;}
#chat .lq773-eyebrow{font-size:9px;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:1.4px;color:#97aab1}#chat #lq771-mood{font:700 14px/1.3 system-ui;color:var(--lq-mood);background:none;border:none;padding:0;margin:0;letter-spacing:0;text-transform:none}#chat #lq773-emotion-source{font-size:10px;color:#aebfc4}#chat #lq773-emotion-detail{font-size:11px;color:#d5e0e1;line-height:1.3}
#chat .lq772-rel{padding:10px;border-color:#b6c3bd20}#chat .lq772-track{position:relative;height:6px;overflow:visible;background:linear-gradient(to right,#8f545d 0 16.666%,#2f4146 16.666%)}#chat #lq772-fill{position:absolute;top:0;width:3px!important;height:10px;transform:translate(-50%,-2px);border-radius:2px;box-shadow:0 0 7px #f5dda999;background:#f1d7a6}
#chat .lq773-relscale{position:relative;height:12px;font-size:9px;color:#aeb9bd;margin-top:5px}#chat .lq773-relscale span{position:absolute;left:0}#chat .lq773-relscale span:nth-child(2){left:16.666%;transform:translateX(-50%)}#chat .lq773-relscale span:last-child{left:auto;right:0}#chat .lq773-facts{font-size:10px;color:#b9cacd;line-height:1.4;display:flex;gap:6px;flex-wrap:wrap}#chat .lq773-facts span{border:1px solid #9ab3ad26;background:#111d25;border-radius:5px;padding:3px 6px}#chat .lq773-facts span[hidden]{display:none}
#chat .lq771-mission{padding:10px!important;box-shadow:inset 0 0 12px #0002}#chat .lq773-reward{font-size:11px;color:#e5c889;font-weight:650}#chat .lq772-title{font-size:27px;letter-spacing:.4px}#chat .lq772-kicker{color:#c9ad7b}#chat .lq772-titlebar{border-bottom:1px solid #c6b28b2b;padding-bottom:10px}
#chat .log{height:clamp(150px,38vh,365px);background:radial-gradient(ellipse at 30% 0,#283e4455,transparent 60%),#101c23!important;border-color:#a0b7b32a;padding:16px!important}
#chat .log>.npc,#chat .log>.me{border-radius:5px 13px 13px 13px!important;background:linear-gradient(145deg,#30424b,#202f39)!important;border-color:#9cb6b63d!important;box-shadow:0 4px 10px #0003;padding:11px 14px!important;line-height:1.6!important}#chat .log>.me{border-radius:13px 5px 13px 13px!important;background:linear-gradient(140deg,#254b47,#203b38)!important}#chat .log>.npc[data-mood]{border-left:2px solid var(--turn-mood,#a0b7b3)!important}#chat .log>.npc .lq77-mood{border-color:var(--turn-mood,#9aabae);color:var(--turn-mood,#b6c6cb);font-weight:700;padding:3px 6px;margin-bottom:3px;}
#chat .log>.fix{border-left:3px solid #c6a5ec!important;background:#322a43!important;color:#eee4fc!important}#chat .log>.natural-alt{border-left:3px solid #85c4ad!important;background:#233b37!important;color:#ddf5e9!important}#chat .log>.voc-badge{border-left:3px solid #8cbde3!important;background:#243649!important;color:#d6e9f9!important}#chat .log>.quest{border-left:3px solid #e6c48b!important;background:#383123!important;color:#ffe5b8!important}#chat .npc-coach{background:#1a2b31;border-color:#9fb9b329}#chat .inrow input:focus{outline:2px solid #d6b77e;outline-offset:1px}#chat button:focus-visible{outline:2px solid #f5d49b;outline-offset:2px}#chat .lq773-provider{font-size:10px;letter-spacing:.2px;color:#a9c2c0;margin-left:auto;text-align:right;white-space:nowrap}
@media(max-width:700px){#chat[style*="display: block"],#chat[style*="display:block"]{grid-template-columns:1fr}#chat{width:calc(100vw - 12px)!important;max-height:calc(100dvh - 12px)!important}#chat .lq772-sidebar,#chat .lq772-main{padding:8px;gap:6px}#chat .lq772-stage{height:90px;width:90px;flex-basis:90px}#chat .lq773-emblem{width:19px;height:19px;font-size:12px;top:5px;right:5px}#chat .lq772-stage:before{inset:3px}#chat .name{font-size:19px!important}#chat .lq773-emotion{padding:3px 6px;margin-top:3px;gap:0}#chat .lq773-emotion .lq773-eyebrow,#chat #lq773-emotion-detail{display:none}#chat #lq771-mood{font-size:11px}#chat #lq773-emotion-source{font-size:9px}#chat .lq773-facts{font-size:9px}#chat .lq773-reward{font-size:9px}#chat .lq772-title{font-size:18px}#chat .lq772-titlebar{padding-bottom:5px}#chat .log{height:clamp(100px,29vh,275px);padding:9px!important}#chat .log>.npc,#chat .log>.me{padding:8px 10px!important}#chat .lq773-provider{display:none}}
@media(max-height:520px){#chat .lq772-stage{height:92px}#chat .lq773-emotion{padding:3px 6px;margin-top:3px}#chat #lq773-emotion-detail,#chat .lq773-emotion .lq773-eyebrow,#chat .lq773-facts{display:none}#chat .lq772-main,#chat .lq772-sidebar{padding:6px;gap:5px}#chat .log{height:105px;min-height:55px;padding:6px!important}#chat .lq772-titlebar{padding-bottom:3px}#chat .lq772-title{font-size:18px}}
@media(max-height:500px) and (max-width:700px){#chat .lq772-stage{height:43px;width:43px;flex-basis:43px}#chat .lq773-emblem{display:none}#chat .lq772-titlebar{display:none}#chat .log{height:80px;min-height:46px}}
@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){#chat *{animation:none!important;transition:none!important}}

</style>
